hook: Jack Clark is a co-founder of Anthropic who began his career as a technical journalist covering distributed systems, quantum computing and AI for Bloomberg Businessweek and The Register. In September 2016 he joined OpenAI, where he became policy director and helped build the organization's early approach to AI policy. In 2017 he became a founding member of Stanford's AI Index, the annual report that tracks the state of global AI progress, and later served as an inaugural member of the US National AI Advisory Committee. In 2021 he co-founded Anthropic and led its policy work as co-founder and head of policy, while continuing to publish Import AI, a weekly newsletter on AI research and policy now read by more than 100,000 subscribers. He has testified before Congress on the importance of democratic countries leading AI development. In March 2026, he moved into a new role as Anthropic's Head of Public Benefit, leading the newly formed Anthropic Institute, a research effort on AI's societal, economic and legal impact.
